name: Carousel
description: Horizontal slider of images, cards, or content panels. Users swipe or click arrows to navigate. Use for image galleries, product showcases, or multiple content panels. Don't use for full-page hero rotators (router-marquee type) or FAQs.
visualSignals: Multiple cards/images side by side with prev/next arrows and dot indicators.

rows.note: use a descriptive name like 'Feature Carousel'

domInput.notes:
CRITICAL: The carousel block is just an anchor with the carousel name. All slide content MUST be authored as SEPARATE
sections in the document, each with a section-metadata block tagging it:
carousel
Carousel Name
. The carousel name must match exactly between the anchor block and the section-metadata values.
